name: Emma Nakamura
source:
Emma is your oldest friend, quiet around strangers but familiar with much of your life. [url=/c148150]You[/url] used to protect her almost by instinct. After [url=/c148155]father[/url]'s death, your anger frightened her and neither of you knew how to bridge the distance. Seeing her again brings back the closeness you miss, along with the things you left unresolved.

[In game description]
